changelog:
DriveFight 0.20.27 — Match scores and server status

- See player and bot counts in the multiplayer lobby.
- Hold Tab or controller View/Select for country flags, car classes, K/D/A and server-measured ping.
- Get assist credit for meaningful recent damage, including shield damage.
- See final scores between online rounds; Arena Battle moves to the next supported map automatically.
- Fixed cosmetic car debris running on the dedicated server, where it could leave invisible shot blockers.
- Clearer website text and controls.

Everyone joining a match must update: matching Mac, Windows and Linux server builds use protocol 14.

Online modes are Arena Battle and Soccer on the configured private host/Tailscale network. CTF, Jungle, Easy Practice and star mechanics remain offline. Windows is cross-built, but interactive Windows gameplay and public non-Tailnet access have not been verified here. A Mac native shutdown crash appeared once after a successful check; the isolated rerun passed, and the engine limitation remains documented.

Free personal, noncommercial preview. Star music made with Suno. Clients are unsigned; installation steps: https://drivefight.vercel.app/
